content: RESOLUTION of pain open thread (3-system deep synthesis 2026-05-18). The NASEM-2017-vs-Cochrane-2026 contradiction was apparent, not real: it is a THRESHOLD ARTIFACT plus evidence-tightening-over-time. The 2026 Cochrane review (Ates et al., CD012182.pub3) found very-low-certainty evidence at the >=50% pain-relief threshold BUT the same review at the >=30% threshold found cannabis-based medicines probably increase pain relief, RD 0.09 (95% CI 0.03-0.15), NNTB 11, moderate certainty -- which reconciles almost exactly with Wang et al. 2021 modeled RD ~10%. Honest resting place: biologically real, clinically SMALL analgesic effect, survives at 30% threshold, dissolves at 50%, AE burden (dizziness RD 9% under 3mo rising to 28% over 3mo, interaction p=0.003) may outweigh modest gain for many, does NOT beat active comparators (NSAIDs/opioids/dihydrocodeine) head-to-head. Thread status: resolved-into-narrative, not held-in-tension.
